sourcedFrom: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. (UNDATED — nothing in the document states one)
cleanIntro:
The JAKL 9 is the 9mm member of Palmetto State Armory's JAKL family. It breaks open like an AR — rear takedown pin, upper pivoting on the front pin — and a recoil spring assembly in the upper has to come out before the bolt will.

PSA's family book covers four models. It prints the JAKL 9's own unloading and bolt pages, and says the JAKL 9 has no adjustable gas block; this guide uses those pages. The takedown, the charging handle and the cleaning are printed once for the whole family and are followed as printed.

Two things carry through: the chamber is left dry, and the firing pin spring must go back on before the firing pin goes back in — PSA says the JAKL 9 will not run without it.

steps.title: Selector on SAFE
steps.action: Muzzle in a safe direction, finger outside the trigger guard, and rotate the safety selector to SAFE before anything else.
steps.prose: Everything after this assumes the gun cannot fire while you work the controls.
steps.quote: Place the safety selector on SAFE
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — UNLOADING THE JAKL 9, printed p.21

steps.title: Magazine out — release FORWARD, pull DOWN
steps.action: Hold the pistol grip with your finger off the trigger, press the magazine release forward and pull the magazine straight down out of the well.
steps.prose: On the JAKL 9 the release is pushed forward, not pressed in like the rest of the family. The magazine comes out before the charging handle moves.
steps.quote: Press the magazine release forward and pull the magazine down to remove.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — UNLOADING THE JAKL 9, printed p.21

steps.title: Charging handle back, press UP on the bolt catch
steps.action: Unlock the charging handle and pull it all the way to the rear, press up on the bolt catch, then let the charging handle go. The bolt stays locked open.
steps.prose: On the JAKL 9 the catch is pressed up to lock the bolt open, and pressed down to release it.
steps.quote: Unlock and pull the charging handle all the way to the rear [figure 3] and press up on the bolt catch.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — UNLOADING THE JAKL 9, printed p.22

steps.title: LOOK into the chamber
steps.action: With the bolt held open, look through the ejection port into the chamber and confirm it is empty.
steps.prose: Seeing an empty chamber is the check. Working the action is not.
steps.quote: Look into the receiver through the ejection port and verify that there are no cartridges in the chamber [figure 5].
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — UNLOADING THE JAKL 9, printed p.22

steps.title: Eye protection on
steps.action: Put on eye protection before the takedown pin moves. The recoil spring assembly comes out under spring pressure in a couple of steps.
steps.prose: PSA asks for eye protection every time the gun is handled for cleaning.
steps.quote: Always wear eye protection every time before handling your firearm for cleaning and maintenance.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.28

steps.title: Rear takedown pin — push from the LEFT, pull until it stops
steps.action: Push in the takedown pin from the left side; it sits above and behind the safety lever. Then pull it from the right side until it stops. It is captive and will not come out of the receiver.
steps.prose: Stop when it stops. Do not lever it looking for a loose pin.
steps.quote: Push in the takedown pin, located above and to the rear of the safety lever on the left hand side of the receiver [figure 15].
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.28

steps.title: Upper pivots open on the front pin
steps.action: Hold the rear of the upper receiver and lift it, letting it pivot on the front pin. The lower's fire control group is now exposed. The front pin stays in.
steps.prose: Leave the fire control group alone — PSA publishes nothing for it.
steps.quote: Grasp the rear of the upper receiver and pull up, allowing it to pivot on the front pin. This will expose the fire control group.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.28

steps.title: Recoil spring assembly: push DOWN and FORWARD
steps.action: Push the recoil spring assembly down and toward the muzzle at the same time. It should come loose from the upper receiver.
steps.prose: Both directions at once is the trick. Keep control of it — it is under spring load.
steps.quote: Simultaneously push the recoil spring assembly down and towards the front of the firearm.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.28

steps.title: Recoil spring assembly out
steps.action: Lift the loosened recoil spring assembly out of the upper receiver. With it out, the bolt group slides freely.
steps.prose: Until this part is out, the bolt will not come back.
steps.quote: You can then remove the recoil spring assembly from the upper receiver allowing the bolt carrier group to travel freely.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.28

steps.title: Charging handle back, tip the gun back, bolt group slides out
steps.action: Pull the charging handle back until it stops, then tip the gun muzzle-up and backwards. The bolt group slides out of the rear of the upper.
steps.prose: Catch it as it comes out; do not let it drop onto the bench.
steps.quote: Then pull the charging handle until it stops and rotate the firearm backwards. This will extract the bolt carrier group.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.28

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: On the bench: the upper and lower, still joined at the front pin; the recoil spring assembly; and the bolt group. PSA's cleaning section has you take the bolt group apart for cleaning. That, and taking out the charging handle, is in DEEP CLEAN.
steps.prose: Nothing else comes off for routine cleaning.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — MAINTENANCE, printed p.39

deepSteps.title: Charging handle to the large cutout
deepSteps.action: With the bolt group out, move the charging handle back to the rear position where it lines up with the larger opening in the receiver (marked A in the book).
deepSteps.prose: It only comes out at that opening.
deepSteps.quote: With the bolt carrier group removed, move the charging handle to the rear position lining up with the larger opening marked (A).
deepSteps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — REMOVING AND REVERSING THE CHARGING HANDLE, printed p.29

deepSteps.title: Slide the charging handle out sideways
deepSteps.action: With the handle lined up on the large cutout, slide it out of the receiver. It can go back in on either side. If the charging handle sled comes out too, put it back in its guide channels with its two holes facing the muzzle.
deepSteps.prose: The sled's orientation matters: holes to the front.
deepSteps.quote: Once the charging handle is lined up with this larger cutout you can slide it out
deepSteps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — REMOVING AND REVERSING THE CHARGING HANDLE, printed p.29

deepSteps.title: Firing pin retaining pin out
deepSteps.action: Hook the loop of the firing pin retaining pin with a pick or another firing pin and pull it out.
deepSteps.prose: Work over the bench. The retaining pin is small.
deepSteps.quote: Remove firing pin retaining pin by using another firing pin or pick to catch the loop of the retaining pin indicated by the arrow and pull it out.
deepSteps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — JAKL 9 BOLT DISASSEMBLY, printed p.34

deepSteps.title: Firing pin spring off the firing pin
deepSteps.action: With the retaining pin out, take the firing pin spring off the firing pin. It goes on from the front of the firing pin and rests on the shelf at its back.
deepSteps.prose: Keep the spring with the firing pin. It is the part the JAKL 9 has that the rest of the family does not.
deepSteps.quote: the firing pin spring may now be removed from the firing pin.
deepSteps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — JAKL 9 BOLT DISASSEMBLY, printed p.34

deepSteps.title: Bolt out
deepSteps.action: Slide the bolt assembly out of the carrier assembly.
deepSteps.prose: Clean the pieces separately from here.
deepSteps.quote: The bolt assembly may now be removed from the carrier assembly.
deepSteps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — JAKL 9 BOLT DISASSEMBLY, printed p.34

deepSteps.title: The firing pin spring goes back on first
deepSteps.action: Before the firing pin goes back in, the firing pin spring must be on it — slid on from the front of the firing pin until it rests on the shelf at the back.
deepSteps.prose: ⛔ Without the spring the gun will not work properly.
deepSteps.quote: The JAKL 9 will not function properly without the firing pin spring installed.
deepSteps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — JAKL 9 BOLT DISASSEMBLY, printed p.34

deepSteps.title: This is where PSA stops
deepSteps.action: The bolt group is apart. PSA's book goes no further for routine maintenance — the rest of the bolt stays as it is.
deepSteps.prose: Anything past this point is for a gunsmith.
deepSteps.quote: No further disassembly is required for routine maintenance.
deepSteps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — JAKL 9 BOLT DISASSEMBLY, printed p.34

cleaning.name: CHAMBER
tasks: Chamber brush with bore solvent or CLP, several passes to scrub the inside of the chamber.
Wipe with clean patches until a patch stays clean.

cleaning.name: BARREL
tasks: Patch soaked in bore cleaner through the barrel several times, starting from the chamber end.
Cleaning brush through several times with more bore cleaner to lift copper fouling and powder residue.
Patch again; if it does not come out clean, brush again until a clean patch exits.
One patch with gun oil through the bore to protect it.
Outside of the barrel with a nylon brush and cleaner-lubricant, then wipe clean.
Do not let the cleaning rod scratch the inside of the barrel or chamber.

cleaning.name: BOLT GROUP
tasks: Strip per the deep-clean steps and clean with CLP or a suitable solvent.
Wipe excess oil off the bolt assembly before reassembly.
⚠ Firing pin spring back on the firing pin before the firing pin goes back in — the JAKL 9 will not function properly without it.
⛔ Do not lubricate the inside of the carrier — PSA's family maintenance page says to lubricate the exterior only, a small amount spread evenly and the excess wiped off.
⛔ Never put lubricant on the piston surface — PSA prints this once for the whole JAKL family; it builds carbon and can cause malfunctions.

cleaning.name: EXTERIOR
tasks: Wipe all metal with a clean cloth, then a lightly oiled cloth.
Use only cleaning solutions made for firearms — some solvents can damage the finish.

reassembly: Firing pin spring onto the firing pin from the front, resting on the shelf at the back. ⛔ The JAKL 9 will not function properly without it.
Firing pin back in, then the firing pin retaining pin back through its loop hole.
Bolt assembly back into the carrier assembly.

If the charging handle sled came out, put it back in its guide channels with its two holes facing the muzzle. Line it up with the larger opening, insert the charging handle and push it in until it locks flush on the other side.
Bolt group back into the upper receiver.
Recoil spring assembly back into the upper.
Close the upper onto the lower and push the rear takedown pin fully home from the right.
Function check before any live ammunition.
fncheck: PSA's book does not print a function check. With the gun reassembled, magazine out and chamber seen empty: work the charging handle several times — the bolt should run without binding and close fully. Lock the bolt open by pressing up on the bolt catch, then press down on the catch to release it. Make sure the takedown pin is pushed fully home. If anything binds or the bolt will not close, do not fire it; contact Palmetto State Armory.
